description: Implementation of the Integrated Regional Development Programme for Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The International Development Association of the World Bank Group is scheduled to grant a financial provision of US$ 1,000 million to the country during the period of 2026-2031, of which US$ 100 million has been allocated for the implementation of the Integrated Regional Development Programme for Northern and Eastern Provinces. Loan negotiations to obtain the relevant loan facility to implement the said programme held between the Government of Sri Lanka and the World Bank Group, as per the approval received at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-02-09 have concluded. The said Integrated Regional Development Programme is expected to strengthen the clusters with economic potential, promote micro, small and medium enterprises, enhance economic opportunities and expand connectivity thereby improving the livelihoods of the people, accelerate regional economic growth in the Northern and Eastern Provinces through sustainable regional development, and enhance competitiveness. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into the necessary financial agreements to obtain the financial facility of US$ 100 million from the International Development Association of the World Bank Group to implement the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.
